capabilities: receive text, photos, voice messages, and URLs via a Telegram or Discord bot
process audio and images with configurable STT, vision, and LLM providers
auto-summarize an idle messaging session into a Markdown note in the vault
carry context across sessions and bind devices with an activation code
encrypt API keys locally with AES-256
extras: README warns that chat content, voice, and images are sent to third-party AI providers you configure, though the plugin itself has no central server. Documentation is provided in English and Simplified Chinese; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture stray thoughts, voice notes, or photos from a messenger and have them turned into structured vault notes automatically.
